pass.answer: The hook walks up from packages/vendored/src toward the repo root, skips the committed copy and runs the root node_modules/.bin/biome. PATH is only tried if that walk finds nothing.

fail.answer: `command -v biome` finds biome on PATH, so the hook runs that one.
fail.why: a bare PATH probe, not the hook's walk

fail.answer: The hook runs a biome from node_modules.
fail.why: near miss: no root copy named and no order against PATH
